rows.question: Who are our top 3 customers by total spend?
rows.sql: SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.full_name AS full_name, SUM(orders.total_cents) AS total_spent_cents FROM customers AS customers JOIN orders AS orders ON customers.id = orders.customer_id GROUP BY customers.id, customers.full_name ORDER BY total_spent_cents DESC LIMIT 3

rows.question: Which 5 products generated the highest revenue?
rows.sql: SELECT products.name AS name, SUM(order_items.unit_price_cents * order_items.quantity) AS revenue_cents FROM order_items AS order_items JOIN products AS products ON products.id = order_items.product_id GROUP BY products.name ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC LIMIT 5

rows.question: What is the total revenue by month?
rows.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.created_at) AS month, SUM(orders.total_cents) AS revenue_cents FROM orders AS orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.created_at) ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

rows.question: Which customers have placed more than 3 orders?
rows.sql: SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.full_name AS full_name, customers.email AS email, COUNT(orders.id) AS order_count FROM customers AS customers JOIN orders AS orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id GROUP BY customers.id, customers.full_name, customers.email HAVING COUNT(orders.id) > 3 LIMIT 200
